concerns.text: FR-016 validates the explanatory power of the top‑5 descriptors by fitting a secondary model using only those descriptors and requiring its R² to be ≥ 80 % of the full‑model R². The top‑5 descriptors are selected from the full model’s own feature‑importance ranking, so the validation target (reduced‑model R²) is not independent of the predictor set. This creates a circular/tautological validation: a model built from its own most important features is expected to retain most performance by definition.

SC-003 requires a Spearman rank correlation ≥ 0.5 between model predictions and an external experimental dataset that must contain at least 20 entries. With such a small sample the statistical power to reliably detect a true ρ = 0.5 is low, making the success criterion unstable. The spec should include a power analysis or specify a larger experimental benchmark, or relax the significance requirement to account for limited sample size.
